decisions.text: type waterfall: the parts mix positive and negative values and running subtotals are the message: a waterfall, each bar starting where the last ended (G1.38)
the steps in the process's own order, as given; a waterfall is never sorted (D-43)

each step a bar from the running total before it to the one after it: rises Product sales, Consulting income, falls Cost of goods, Admin expenses, green where it rises and red where it falls, higher being good (R15-11, G4.16); Net income full bars from zero in the reserved grey (G4.15), each equal to the running total there (G7.33)
digits hidden: millions, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$8 million (net income)”
wrapped onto two lines: Product sales, Consulting income, Cost of goods, Admin expenses, Net income
the unit phrase on the top label: “$8 million (net income)”; the top gridline starts after it
a hairline connector at each running total, from one bar to the next (s. 0237)

static output, in colour: one file, red for bad and green for good, plain, for every reader (D-18; owner, 1 Oct 2026); black and white (audience.bw_risk) adds the textures, and a style may choose the colour-blind-safe pair (--good-bad-mode: safe-pair)

source.shows: gains good and costs bad for this audience: green and red, as the book's figure (G4.16, D-18)
